thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — node provisioning batch #7 is blocked in staging, need cross-team help. Kube join failing on node-07, looks like TLS/cert issue.
Zane: On it. Which step is failing exactly? kubelet join or cloud-init?
Maya: kubelet join. Error snippet from node-07: ```time=\"2026-03-10T14:12:06Z\" level=error msg=\"x509: certificate signed by unknown authority\"```
Lia: That rings a bell — we rolled a tiny firewall/acl change yesterday for mgmt-subnet. I filed PR 482 to open port 6443 for staging; it's still pending review.
Devon: Pinged the PR, I can review + merge if infra tests pass. Which test is failing in CI?
infra-bot: CI pipeline for infra/pr-482: smoke-network-tests FAILED (1/12). Link: https://ci.redwood/s/infra/482
Zane: The route table for rt-ml-gw wasn't attached to the staging subnet, so kubelet couldn't reach the control plane CA endpoint. I can attach it but want assurance we only touch staging, not Dedicated prod pools.
Maya: Please attach to staging only. We're trying to verify the provisioning flow before we touch any reserved capacity.
Sasha: Heads-up from product: customers on Dedicated can't have provisioning interruptions past 3/22. If this impacts timelines we need to flag risk.
Diego: Are we blocked on hardware or just network config? Procurement said last H100 batch shipped but a few nodes are still in transit.
Zane: This specific failure is network-only — no hardware required. But separate on procurement: cargo manifest shows 3 racks delayed, ETA 2026-03-20 per vendor.
Maya: Ok, so two separate things: (1) staging kubejoin fail (network ACL); (2) procurement slight delay for one rack but doesn't block current reservations.
Lia: I'll expedite PR 482 review and add the firewall rule to staging now. After merge I can run a rolling reconcile: ```curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/reconcile?env=staging&subset=batch7```
Devon: After merge I'll kick the infra smoke job locally. If it passes I can merge and trigger the reconciler.
infra-bot: Action: PR 482 merged by Devon at 2026-03-10T14:27:03Z. Triggering smoke-network-tests...
infra-bot: smoke-network-tests PASSED (12/12).
Maya: Thanks — re-run node provisioning for batch #7?
Zane: Re-run started: provisioning job id p-20260310-7. Watching logs.
Maya: Node-07 now completed kube join, kubelet registered, but node shows NotReady for a minute — kube-proxy failing to mount cni plugin. Log: ```error opening /var/lib/cni/networks: permission denied```
Lia: That's from a missing systemd unit ordering bug we've seen. I'll push a small systemd drop-in to ensure cni-dir exists before k8s starts. Pushing change to staging AMI build.
Devon: If you can push the AMI patch we can re-provision just node-07. Can you also add a one-off systemd unit check in the provisioning playbook to create the dir as fallback?
Lia: Yes, adding both. Patch: ```- name: ensure cni dir exist
  file: path=/var/lib/cni/networks state=directory owner=root mode=0755```
Diego: FYI capacity reservations: I updated the Dedicated booking sheet — if we lose two racks we'll need to shift some low-priority customers off the 4/1 reservation window. Not critical yet but flagging.
Sasha: Please add a row in the risk log and tag customer-facing teams. I'll prepare a short email if it looks like ETA slips beyond 3/22.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Plan of action: (1) Lia push AMI + systemd fallback (in progress), (2) Devon merge + trigger reconcile (done), (3) Zane re-run provisioning (in progress), (4) Diego monitor procurement and update reservations if ETA changes. I'll update this thread when batch #7 is green.
Zane: Re-provision done: 6/7 nodes Ready, node-07 Ready after AMI patch. All healthchecks passing. :tada:
Maya: Awesome. Marking batch #7 as complete for staging. I'll start a separate rollout plan doc for dedicated pool cutover.
Sasha: Great. If procurement eta gets pushed again, let's coord a customer comms draft.
Diego: Will update the booking sheet and ping sales ops if anything changes.
Maya: Closing this thread for now. If anything else pops up, @here call. :thumbsup:
